name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause 2, Response(at_exit, holding_box), is wrong. The task says carry the box to the exit: reaching the exit must happen with the box already held, which is Response(holding_box, at_exit), paired with Existence(at_exit). Response(at_exit, holding_box) instead asks for a pickup at or after reaching the exit, an order the task never states; it lets the agent wander the room empty-handed and pick up the box at the very end. Replace it with Response(holding_box, at_exit); keep Existence(at_exit) and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(holding_box, at_exit) require the agent to reach the exit holding the box; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) enforces picking the box up on the very next step after each fall. The environment forbids falls on the exit step, so the ChainResponse cannot be violated at the exit. All clauses trace to the task and are hard as required.
